description: Source code for the 'filestore' package in Mattermost, defining interfaces, constants, and functions for file storage backends (local and S3).

classes.name: FileBackend
classes.description: Interface defining methods for file storage backends (e.g., S3, local).

classes.name: FileBackendWithLinkGenerator
classes.description: Interface for generating public links for files.

methods.name: NewFileBackendSettingsFromConfig
methods.description: Creates FileBackendSettings from a given FileSettings object, considering compliance features and skip verification.

methods.name: NewExportFileBackendSettingsFromConfig
methods.description: Creates export-specific FileBackendSettings from a FileSettings object.

methods.name: CheckMandatoryS3Fields
methods.description: Validates that essential S3 fields are set in the configuration.

methods.name: NewFileBackend
methods.description: Creates a new file backend instance based on settings.

methods.name: NewExportFileBackend
